## 1. Story ONE paragraph reconciling your per-(t, view) captions above with the sensor narrative. Walk through the keyframe phases in order. Reference sensor timestamps explicitly. If vision and sensor disagree, FLAG the contradiction — do NOT average. If a substage from the expected list was skipped, performed out of order, or never completed, call it out by name.

Sensor signals like "gripper released" or "arm retracted" describe the robot's action — they do NOT prove the world state. A release without the object reaching its goal is a failure.

```json { "result": "success" | "failure", "onset_t": , "reason": { "expected": "", "observed": "", "result": "" }, "type": "[one of: wrong_sequence | wrong_object | wrong_gripper | wrong_placement | closing_error | open_error | translation_error | orientation_error | avoidable_intervention | unavoidable_intervention]", "avoidance": "[smallest concrete physical action BEFORE onset_t that closes the Expected−Observed gap]" } ```
If `result` is `"success"`, omit `type`, `onset_t`, `reason`, `avoidance`.
